verdict.rationale: The CLI provides `skills init [name]` to scaffold a new SKILL.md template and the specification.io site documents the SKILL.md frontmatter/spec plus a `skills-ref validate` tool, giving an agent the pieces to author and validate a new skill against the project's own spec. However, there's no evidence of a documented end-to-end 'meta-skill' or guided authoring workflow (e.g., a skill-creator skill is only referenced by name in an example, not shown as an authoring guide), nor independent/hands-on confirmation that agents successfully author skills this way. missing for 10: a documented meta-skill/guided authoring workflow beyond template scaffolding, hands-on or community evidence of successful end-to-end authoring, and clearer linkage between `skills init` and the specification/validation steps.
